3902_2023|exchange_line.note: Gross claims and loss adjustment expenses roll-forward (note 12, p30): 164,113 - 45,488 + 81,383 - 6,471 - 8,296 = 185,241, equal to 'At 31 December 185,241'. Exchange (8,296) / 164,113 = -5.055%, just 5% or more in absolute value, so condition (b) holds. Condition (a) fails: every common cell for underwriting years before 2022 is lower in the 2023 report than in the 2022 report by about 3.6% to 5.1% (e.g. UY2021 2 years 85,562 -> 81,243; UY2020 1 year 38,238 -> 36,868; UY2019 4 years 61,520 -> 58,650), i.e. the table was retranslated at the new rate (GBP/USD +5.51%). So the table is retranslated: keep. Marginal on (b): 5.055% against the 5% line.
